message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Four relevant vulnerability groups were newly published or substantively updated during this scan's 24-hour window. Immediate review is recommended for exposed WordPress sites because active exploitation is reported; Chrome and MongoDB Compass updates should also be prioritized according to exposure.

**Scope**

- Sources: `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only; obvious aliases and duplicates were normalized.
- `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined with this run.
- Window: 2026-09-24 05:10 IST through 2026-09-25 05:10 IST (2026-09-23 23:40 UTC through 2026-09-24 23:40 UTC).

**Finding 1 - WordPress Core: CVE-2026-87902**

- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.2.
- Description: A page-template path traversal flaw can allow an unauthenticated attacker to include a readable local PHP file and, when stated theme and server preconditions are present, achieve remote code execution.
- Fresh development: Reporting inside this window says probing escalated to active exploitation and attacker-controlled PHP file writes.
- Relevance: WordPress is explicitly present in the monitored product list.
- Sources: [WordPress advisory](https://github.com/WordPress/wordpress-develop/security/advisories/GHSA-7hp8-65ch-5whp), [Patchstack exploitation update](https://patchstack.com/articles/cve-2026-87902-attackers-started-probing-wordpress-sites-hours-after-the-patch/)

**Finding 2 - Google Chrome Desktop: CVE-2026-93372 through CVE-2026-93387**

- Severity: High (CERT-In rating).
- Description: Sixteen vulnerabilities cover use-after-free, buffer overflow, type confusion, authorization, race-condition, information-disclosure, out-of-bounds-read, SSRF, and UI-spoofing weaknesses. Successful exploitation could lead to code execution, information exposure, security-control bypass, spoofing, or denial of service.
- Affected versions: Chrome before 153.0.8010.52/.53 on Windows and macOS and before 153.0.8010.52 on Linux, according to CERT-In.
- Relevance: Google Chrome appears in both assigned primary inventories.
- Sources: [CERT-In CIVN-2026-0474](https://www.cert-in.org.in/s2cMainServlet?VLCODE=CIVN-2026-0474&pageid=PUBVLNOTES01), [Google Chrome release notice](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/09/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_0194356994.html)

**Finding 3 - MongoDB Compass: CVE-2026-96750**

- Severity: High, CVSS 3.1 score 7.1.
- Description: Compass can place an unescaped, server-supplied database name into the initial input of its embedded MongoDB shell. A user who can create databases may cause content to execute in the Compass process when another user opens the shell for that database.
- Affected versions: MongoDB Compass 1.44.0 through versions earlier than 1.49.12.
- Relevance: MongoDB is monitored as a product family, and Compass is an official MongoDB component covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- Sources: [Official MongoDB Compass 1.49.12 release](https://github.com/mongodb-js/compass/releases/tag/v1.49.12), [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-96750)

**Finding 4 - Ubuntu security updates: USN-8810-1 through USN-8818-1**

- Severity: Varies; Ubuntu does not state one overall severity for this consolidated group.
- Description: Ubuntu published nine security notices covering ImageMagick, urllib3, GDAL, Expat, Octavia, libass, and three Linux-kernel update sets. Supported Ubuntu releases, including monitored Ubuntu 22.04 LTS in multiple notices, received fixes for issues that can include crashes, information exposure, security bypasses, denial of service, and arbitrary code execution.
- Relevance: Ubuntu and Ubuntu 22.04 are explicitly present in the assigned inventories; package applicability depends on the installed release and package set.
- Source: [Ubuntu Security Notices](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices)

**MongoDB ecosystem verification**

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services. CVE-2026-96750 was the only credible MongoDB-family finding inside this window. Older MongoDB Server, driver, Mongoid, and Entity Framework provider advisories were excluded as out of scope.

**Freshness exclusions**

Microsoft Outlook CVE-2026-70125 was published at 2026-09-23 22:40 UTC, one hour before the cutoff. Apache Tomcat's September 23 batch also predates the cutoff. September 24 coverage of SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted and ManageEngine products repeated vendor advisories or fixes that predated the window without a newly verified security development, so those items were not reported as new.

**Review priority**

Treat WordPress as urgent because credible reporting describes active exploitation. Prioritize Chrome and MongoDB Compass updates based on deployment exposure, and review the applicable Ubuntu notices against installed releases and packages.
